highlights.title: From Mai 68 to 2026: France’s long student protests tradition
highlights.summary: Students, parents and trade unions were demonstrating across France Tuesday, protesting what they say is under-investment in high schools. From Mai 68 to the CPE crisis in 2006, major French student and youth protests have pressured leaders and transformed national politics.
